title: ComfortLease Equipment Leases — Buyout, Early Termination, Upgrade and Ownership at Term End
content:
*Contract clauses applying to every ComfortLease Equipment Leases agreement.*

**Clause 1 — The lessee's decision.** Buying out or terminating a lease early is the lessee's own decision, recorded as a request the lessee confirms. A buyout or early termination takes effect only once the lessee has confirmed the request on the lease.

**Clause 2 — Buyout.** A buyout charges the price for the current lease year from the system's buyout price schedule, quoted for 15 calendar days, and ownership passes on payment. A lease that is bought out takes bought out status.

**Clause 3 — End of term.** At the end of the lease term the equipment passes to the lessee with no buyout charge, where the system provides for ownership at term end; the lease then takes bought out status.

**Clause 4 — Early termination.** An early termination charges 6 months of the current rent plus the removal fee of $295.00, and the equipment is removed. A lease terminated early takes terminated status.

**Clause 5 — Upgrade.** A lessee who upgrades to another lease mid-term, where the system allows an upgrade during the lease, receives 10% of the rent paid toward the new lease and pays no early termination charge.

## Terms by system

| Leased system | Lease term | Ownership passes at term end | Buyout quote valid | Months of current rent on early termination | Removal fee | Upgrade during lease allowed | Upgrade credit, share of rent paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | 120 months | Yes | 15 days | 6 | $295.00 | Yes | 10% |
| ComfortLease Central Air | 120 months | Yes | 15 days | 6 | $295.00 | Yes | 10% |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | 120 months | Yes | 15 days | 6 | $295.00 | Yes | 10% |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | 144 months | Yes | 15 days | 6 | $295.00 | Yes | 10% |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | 144 months | Yes | 15 days | 6 | $295.00 | Yes | 10% |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | 120 months | Yes | 15 days | 6 | $295.00 | Yes | 10% |

## Clause 1 in the records

A buyout or early termination request on the lease shows one of three standings: awaiting the lessee's confirmation, confirmed, or withdrawn. Only a request the lessee has confirmed, on that same lease, lets the buyout or early termination take effect; a request awaiting confirmation or withdrawn does not.

## The current lease year

The lease year in effect is counted from the installation date: the twelve months starting on the installation date are lease year 1, the next twelve months lease year 2, and so on. Hypothetical example: for a lease installed on 15 June of one year, 14 June three years later still falls in lease year 3, and 15 June three years later begins lease year 4.

## Worked charges (hypothetical leases)

- **Early termination.** A hypothetical current monthly rent of $84.00: 6 months of rent is $504.00; plus the $295.00 removal fee, the early termination charge is $799.00 in total. The current rent is the monthly rent in effect at the time, including every anniversary increase already applied.
- **Upgrade.** A hypothetical lessee who has paid $3000.00 in rent upgrades mid-term: 10% of $3000.00 is $300.00, received toward the new lease, and no early termination charge applies.
- **End of term.** A ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air lease reaching the end of its 144-month term: the equipment passes to the lessee with no buyout charge.
